Acceptance 5: timeout/close/dispose settle startup/eval/fs, terminate Worker and reject late readiness
corrupt-input × boot config: invalid public options reject without Worker/SW effects
quota-perm-fail × native acquisition: required rejection/teardown and observable preferred fallback

torn-state × close/dispose during boot: pending calls reject without late revival
sibling-drift × restart: captured namespace and startup budget remain effective
